_comment: The public phase-1 (Powers of Tau) files the Veyl phase-2 ceremony starts from: the Perpetual Powers of Tau (an open multi-party ceremony, 54 contributions and a random beacon), prepared for phase 2 and truncated by the Hermez / Polygon team. Each circuit starts from the smallest file large enough for it (ceremony/circuits.json `power`): withdraw 2^14, transact and position 2^15. The blake2b-512 hashes are the ones the snarkjs README publishes for these files (section 7, 'Prepare phase 2'); `init` and `verify` refuse any other file (except in a rehearsal). The files are NOT committed: download them and check them with `b2sum`.
hashPublishedAt: https://github.com/iden3/snarkjs/blob/master/README.md (section 7, 'Prepare phase 2': table of prepared ptau files and their blake2b hashes)
